mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 66 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the waning crescent moon, we are looking at an overnight low of 58 degrees with no rain predicted.

City news includes a major update on the Aldi development and Highway M construction. Starting the week of September 7, expect traffic shifts and one-lane traffic in both directions for approximately three weeks. Additionally, the Verona Police Department announced the arrest of a school staff member following an investigation into a relationship that occurred in 2019.

There is a lot happening this week in Verona. Start with yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness. Tuesday is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. On Wednesday, join the community at the downtown farmers market or grab pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding the police report, on Sunday, August 30, the school district notified authorities of an incident involving a staff member, leading to an arrest for sexual assault of a child.
Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Since the store is now closed for the evening, we look forward to serving you Georgia Peach when we reopen tomorrow morning at 10 AM.
